title: What happened to Johnny Klebitz in GTA 5
subject: johnny
description:
Did Johnny deserve a better ending? 👇

Five years after The Lost and Damned, Johnny Klebitz met Trevor Philips in Sandy Shores. Spoilers for GTA IV: The Lost and Damned and GTA V.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Five years after the biker war, Johnny Klebitz lived in a trailer.
The Lost now rode in Blaine County, and Johnny looked thin and worn down.
Ashley Butler, the addict he never let go of in Liberty City, was still at his side.
Then Johnny came face to face with Trevor Philips in Sandy Shores.
In Trevor's first mission, Mr. Philips, Johnny was dead within seconds of the opening cutscene.
Fans believe Rockstar did it on purpose, to show players exactly who Trevor was.
The man who outlived his own president died in a desert trailer park.
